FROM lcr.loongnix.cn/library/eclipse-temurin:8u492-b09-jdk
WORKDIR /app
COPY sentinel-dashboard.jar /app/
ENV TZ=Asia/Shanghai
EXPOSE 8858
ENTRYPOINT ["java","-Dserver.port=8858","-jar","/app/sentinel-dashboard.jar"]

FROM lcr.loongnix.cn/library/eclipse-temurin:21-jdk AS native
RUN printf 'Types: deb\nURIs: http://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/debian\nSuites: sid\nComponents: main\nSigned-By: /usr/share/keyrings/debian-archive-keyring.gpg\n' > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/debian.sources && rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends gcc libc6-dev && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
COPY amal/sqlite3.c /tmp/
COPY amal/sqlite3.h /tmp/
COPY NativeDB.c /tmp/
COPY NativeDB.java /tmp/
COPY sqlite-jdbc.jar /tmp/
WORKDIR /tmp
RUN javac -cp sqlite-jdbc.jar -h /tmp/jni NativeDB.java && mv /tmp/jni/org_sqlite_core_NativeDB.h /tmp/NativeDB.h
RUN gcc -shared -fPIC -O2 -D_GNU_SOURCE -DSQLITE_ENABLE_FTS5 -DSQLITE_ENABLE_RTREE -DSQLITE_ENABLE_COLUMN_METADATA -I$JAVA_HOME/include -I$JAVA_HOME/include/linux -I/tmp/jni -o libsqlitejdbc.so NativeDB.c sqlite3.c -lpthread -ldl

FROM lcr.loongnix.cn/library/eclipse-temurin:21-jdk
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=native /tmp/libsqlitejdbc.so /usr/lib/libsqlitejdbc.so
COPY komga.jar /app/komga.jar
ENV TZ=Asia/Shanghai SERVER_PORT=8080 JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS=-Djava.library.path=/usr/lib
EXPOSE 8080
ENTRYPOINT ["java","-jar","/app/komga.jar"]

files.entry.sh:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
mkdir -p /bitnami/kafka
PROP=/opt/kafka/config/loong.properties
cat > $PROP <<'EOF'
process.roles=broker,controller
node.id=1
controller.quorum.voters=1@localhost:9093
controller.listener.names=CONTROLLER
listener.security.protocol.map=CONTROLLER:PLAINTEXT,PLAINTEXT:PLAINTEXT
num.network.threads=3
num.io.threads=8
socket.send.buffer.bytes=102400
socket.receive.buffer.bytes=102400
socket.request.max.bytes=104857600
num.partitions=1
default.replication.factor=1
offsets.topic.replication.factor=1
transaction.state.log.replication.factor=1
transaction.state.log.min.isr=1
log.retention.hours=168
log.segment.bytes=1073741824
group.initial.rebalance.delay.ms=0
EOF
echo "listeners=${KAFKA_CFG_LISTENERS:-PLAINTEXT://:9092,CONTROLLER://:9093}" >> $PROP
echo "advertised.listeners=${KAFKA_CFG_ADVERTISED_LISTENERS:-PLAINTEXT://localhost:9092}" >> $PROP
echo "log.dirs=/bitnami/kafka" >> $PROP
for var in $(printenv | sed -n 's/^KAFKA_CFG_\([^=]*\)=.*/\1/p'); do
  prop=$(echo "$var" | tr 'A-Z_' 'a-z.')
  val=$(printenv "KAFKA_CFG_$var")
  case "$prop" in listeners|advertised.listeners|log.dirs) sed -i "s|^$prop=.*|$prop=$val|" $PROP ;; *) echo "$prop=$val" >> $PROP ;; esac
done
if [ ! -f /bitnami/kafka/meta.properties ]; then
  /opt/kafka/bin/kafka-storage.sh format --standalone -t "$(/opt/kafka/bin/kafka-storage.sh random-uuid)" -c "$PROP" --ignore-formatted
fi
exec /opt/kafka/bin/kafka-server-start.sh $PROP

EXPOSE 9092 9093
ENTRYPOINT ["/entry.sh"]
